en.headline: Observatory cancels Strong Monsoon Signal after morning winds ease
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal was cancelled at 12:45 pm on Monday as easterly winds moderated.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Strong Monsoon Signal at 12:45 pm on Monday. The signal had been updated earlier in the day with expectations of strong easterly winds and occasional gale-force gusts.
According to the Observatory, a fresh to strong easterly airstream had been affecting the coast of Guangdong. With the signal lifted, the public was no longer under the specific monsoon wind warning.

Forecasters said winds would turn more northerly from Tuesday as a northeast monsoon arrives, bringing cooler conditions later in the week with urban temperatures expected to fall toward 16 degrees on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 天文台取消強烈季候風信號 上午風勢緩和
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號於周一中午12時45分取消，偏東風勢減弱。
body: 香港天文台於周一中午12時45分取消強烈季候風信號。該信號較早時更新，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台指，一股清勁至強風程度的偏東氣流正影響廣東沿岸。信號取消後，市民不再受特定季候風警告約束。
預報指，東北季候風將於周二抵達，風向轉為偏北，周中天氣轉涼，市區氣溫周三可跌至約16度。
